research_result.description: Pylon is a customer support and helpdesk platform designed for B2B teams, offering issue tracking, account intelligence, and AI integration capabilities.
research_result.credential_requirements: API tokens are generated from the Pylon dashboard under Settings -> API Tokens by an account Admin. MCP access is configured under Settings -> AI Controls -> MCP Server and uses OAuth 2.0 authentication.

evidence.claim: The Pylon API uses REST principles and Bearer authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication. This means you’ll need to pass your API token in the header of your request:

evidence.claim: Pylon provides a dedicated MCP server for AI tools with OAuth 2.0 authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Pylon MCP Server exposes Pylon data to AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).

evidence.claim: Pylon MCP uses OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit) for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Auth: OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit). Actions are performed on behalf of the authenticated user; access is scoped to the same data as in the Pylon dashboard.

evidence.claim: API tokens must be created by an Admin in the Pylon dashboard.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You must be an Admin to access the API tokens page and create a token. If you are not an admin, ask an admin on your team!
